stories.title: Coalition intercepts Houthi ballistic missile north of Riyadh, tracks launch site in Sanaa

en.title: Coalition intercepts Houthi ballistic missile north of Riyadh, tracks launch site in Sanaa
en.summary: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis north of Riyadh. The coalition stated it is tracking the missile's launch platform over Sanaa through its intelligence systems.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Underscores Support for Legitimate Yemeni Govt to End Houthi Coup

en.title: Saudi Arabia Underscores Support for Legitimate Yemeni Govt to End Houthi Coup
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has reaffirmed its backing for Yemen's legitimate government and its stance against the Houthi movement's control.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia end 22-year Arabian Gulf Cup drought with comfortable victory over UAE

en.title: Saudi Arabia end 22-year Arabian Gulf Cup drought with comfortable victory over UAE
en.summary: Saudi Arabia won the Arabian Gulf Cup championship for the first time since 2003/04, defeating the UAE 2-0 in the final with goals scored in the first 13 minutes.

stories.title: Saudi FM Discusses Regional Developments with Egyptian, Jordanian Counterparts

en.title: Saudi FM Discusses Regional Developments with Egyptian, Jordanian Counterparts
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister held discussions with Egyptian and Jordanian officials regarding regional developments.

stories.title: Coalition: Ballistic Missile Launched by Terrorist Houthis at Khamis Mushait Destroyed

en.title: Coalition: Ballistic Missile Launched by Terrorist Houthis at Khamis Mushait Destroyed
en.summary: The coalition destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis targeting Khamis Mushait.

stories.title: Egyptian, Jordanian FMs express solidarity with Saudi Arabia in call with Prince Faisal

en.title: Egyptian, Jordanian FMs express solidarity with Saudi Arabia in call with Prince Faisal
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan spoke by phone with the foreign ministers of Egypt and Jordan, who expressed support for Saudi Arabia against Houthi militia aggression. The ministers discussed strengthening bilateral relations and cooperation between the countries.

stories.title: Saudi, Italian Defense Ministers Discuss Military Cooperation

en.title: Saudi, Italian Defense Ministers Discuss Military Cooperation
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's and Italy's defense ministers held discussions regarding military and defense cooperation between the two nations.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince Donates Blood, Launches Annual Donation Campaign for 2026

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince Donates Blood, Launches Annual Donation Campaign for 2026
en.summary: The Saudi Crown Prince participated in a blood donation and initiated an annual donation campaign for 2026 as a humanitarian initiative promoting social solidarity.

stories.title: Saudi defense minister discusses military cooperation with Italian counterpart

en.title: Saudi defense minister discusses military cooperation with Italian counterpart
en.summary: Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman spoke with Italy's Defense Minister Guido Crosetto about military cooperation between their countries and regional security matters.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Syrian President Al-Sharaa discuss bolstering bilateral cooperation

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Syrian President Al-Sharaa discuss bolstering bilateral cooperation
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met with Syrian President Ahmad Al-Sharaa in Riyadh to review bilateral relations and explore cooperation opportunities across various fields and regional developments.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Bolsters Food Security with $798 Million for Strategic Commodities

en.title: Saudi Arabia Bolsters Food Security with $798 Million for Strategic Commodities
en.summary: Saudi Arabia allocated 798 million dollars toward food security and strategic commodity reserves.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia moves to spending restraint in 2027 despite wider 2026 deficit: Moody’s

en.title: Saudi Arabia moves to spending restraint in 2027 despite wider 2026 deficit: Moody's
en.summary: Moody's Ratings indicated Saudi Arabia plans fiscal restraint in 2027 following a larger deficit in 2026, citing the kingdom's strong fiscal fundamentals as supporting its credit rating.

stories.title: ‎Fitch previews Saudi Arabia’s fiscal outlook in 2027 pre-budget statement

en.title: Fitch previews Saudi Arabia's fiscal outlook in 2027 pre-budget statement
en.summary: Fitch Ratings indicates Saudi Arabia faces fiscal pressures from regional tensions, with higher spending and wider deficits projected initially. However, deficits are expected to narrow through 2029 and remain smaller than Fitch's previous forecasts.

stories.title: ‎Cabinet approves tie-up with Turkey on renewable energy projects

en.title: Cabinet approves tie-up with Turkey on renewable energy projects
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Cabinet approved an agreement with Turkey for renewable energy power plant projects. The Cabinet also reviewed preliminary budget estimates for the coming year.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Oct. 4
en.summary: The Saudi stock exchange announced major ownership changes occurring on October 4.

stories.title: ‎MIS CEO declines contract renewal, Ibrahim Al Moammar to take over

en.title: MIS CEO declines contract renewal, Ibrahim Al Moammar to take over
en.summary: Al Moammar Information Systems CEO Abdullah AlGhamdi declined contract renewal for personal reasons. Vice Chairman Ibrahim Al Moammar will assume executive management duties from November 1 until a permanent CEO is appointed.
